description: Implement an A/B testing system for the pricing page that shows different calculator experiences to users based on a PostHog feature flag. The control group should see the existing pricing calculator, while the test group should see an enhanced version with interactive instance sizing, multi-project support, and real-time cost estimates.
functional_requirements: Integrate PostHog client-side feature flag evaluation on the pricing page to determine which calculator variant to display
Create a new pricing calculator component with interactive sliders for instance sizing, ability to add/remove multiple project instances, and real-time monthly cost calculations
Implement a toggle between Pro and Team plans that dynamically updates pricing calculations and displays
Add an expandable pricing table that shows detailed compute specifications and pricing breakdowns
Ensure the experiment only affects the /pricing page and maintains the existing calculator as the control variant
Structure the code so new components exist alongside existing ones without modifying the control path
